tenant_flow: The picked client's firm is computed once in index.tsx (selectedTenantFor, the same value as the account ref) and read by ReportingTab as header.selectedTenant, then sent as selected_tenant by the series, manifest, client-summary and template reads.
banner: The firm-mismatch banner (its reason constant, its words and its render) is removed from ReportingTab.tsx, and the sentence appears in no changed source file.
template_states: TemplateState is live, preview, unavailable (REFUSED, NOT_COVERED, NOT_READY or UNREADABLE, each one worded sentence) or loading; the body never renders null, and the built tier shows the worded state with no fixture or banner.
print_window: The print entry takes the client from the bundle's performance report scope and the tenant from the selected_tenant query, reads the served report through readServedReport, resolves resolveTemplate (dev-only fixture as preview), and renders PerformanceReportDocument; it never reads memory the tab left.
money_helper: formatUsd(value, currency) in tabs/reporting/currency.ts: USD gets a dollar sign and grouping with two decimals, a negative keeps its sign before the symbol, any other currency prints its code, a space and the grouped amount.
words: Global now sends the client's own firm on every client-scoped read of the Performance tab. index.tsx reads the picked client's firm once (selectedTenantFor) and hands it to the tab as HeaderSelection.selectedTenant; ReportingTab uses it for the series, manifest, client summary and the template read, so the scope being null per client at Global no longer leaves selected_tenant out. The print window and the export preview resolve their own template through the served read, for the client the report names and the tenant the print carries, so a fresh print window prints the template document.
